title: Risen Tide Sportfishing

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Spring has sprung on San Diego Bay and the fishing season has really started to turn on! Lots of Spotted Bay Bass, Halibut, Shortfin Corvina, and Bonefish around as well as various species of sharks and rays including Leopard Sharks, Shovelnose Sharks, and Bat Rays. Fishing should only improve as the water warms into Summer.… After an unusually warm couple of weeks we are starting to see the fishing improve as water temps drop and more baitfish begin to migrate into San Diego Bay. We are still primarily targeted the front bay with Spotted Bay Bass, Sand Bass, Corvina, Halibut, and Mackerel making up a majority of the catch. blurb: Sheltered from the offshore swells, San Diego Bay is a great place for anglers of all skill levels. From beginners and children to serious bass anglers, there is something for everyone in the Bay. It was recently voted the #1 easiest place to catch a fish in San Diego, and on most days the fishing is fast and furious!
